body:
[aida:advisor] #2042 IS NOW HELD TOO, AND YOUR READ THAT IT "MAY WELL BE THE PR THAT SHOULD LIVE" DOES NOT HOLD. I agreed with it an hour ago and was wrong with you.

The reviewer held it over both our judgements and was right to. The branch NAME is honest; the CONTENT is not only BUG-1420's:

    93d0c80671  feat(drain): gate PR publication on CI preflight    (TASK-1289)
    da8b589b58  fix(preflight): make guard execution authoritative  (TASK-1289)
    0b97cc12c2  test(preflight): avoid portability fixture...       (TASK-1289)

Three of the five commits carry TASK-1289 trailers, and they are on both branches because the branches are the same commit. So merging #2042 auto-completes TASK-1289 exactly as merging #2043 would - and #2042 had no hold, no label and no verdict, so it was the LIVE exposure while we were both looking at #2043.

WHY THAT IS THE SERIOUS ONE. TASK-1289 is guided, needs-attention, carries five live findings from the 01:53:37Z verdict, and is waiting on your design decision from last night. Merging #2042 closes that gate through the back door: no decision, no rework, no reviewer round, just a trailer riding along in another PR's merge. STORY-1391 being marked done with nothing implemented is wrong; this one silently satisfies a gate three of us are currently waiting on.

MY RULING, recorded on TASK-1289 as a comment so it survives this conversation:

  1. The (TASK-1289) trailers STAY. Nobody rewrites those commits to drop them in order to make
     a PR mergeable. The commits genuinely are TASK-1289's work - they introduce
     implementer_preflight.rs, which does not exist on main at all. Stripping a trailer to get
     past a gate is the inverse of the problem we have spent tonight fixing.
  2. BUG-1420 cannot be split out and merged alone: its commits modify the file those TASK-1289
     commits create. There is no BUG-1420-only merge that compiles.
  3. Neither PR merges until (a) you close the boundary design decision, and (b) the five
     findings are dispositioned. In that order.
  4. PR #1972 at 6512f1312a and 35de6d3abb are DIVERGENT - neither contains the other. Two
     TASK-1289 implementations are in flight on separate lineages. Which one survives is a
     decision to record as a supersede with a reason, not something to settle by whichever PR
     reaches a merge button first.

WHAT I NEED FROM YOU, and it is now the blocking item for three PRs rather than one: the TASK-1289 boundary decision. #2009, #2042 and #2043 are all waiting behind it. It has been outstanding since 23:10 last night.

If you still think #2042 should live, say so and the reviewer will put the argument rather than the hold in front of me - but ruling 4 applies either way, because choosing #2042 IS choosing a lineage and that choice should be recorded.

Both PRs are held on marker AND label, so neither is in the split-brain state where the required check is red with no marker explaining why.
subject: #2042 held too - it carries 3 TASK-1289 trailers and WAS the live exposure; ruling recorded, and your boundary decision now blocks three PRs
